audit_items.proof_trace: The implementation correctly maintains the proposer lookahead invariant. It shifts out the oldest epoch (N) and appends proposers for epoch N+MinSeedLookahead+1, preserving the (MinSeedLookahead+1)*SlotsPerEpoch total size. PrecomputeProposerIndices guarantees exactly SlotsPerEpoch entries, and SetProposerLookahead validates the final array length before committing.
